answer: According to EDPB Statement 3/2024, data protection authorities (DPAs) must supervise as market surveillance authorities (MSAs) the high-risk AI systems listed in points 1, 6, 7, and 8 of Annex III of the AI Act, particularly those used for law enforcement purposes, border management, and justice and democracy. The EDPB recommends that DPAs should be designated as the single points of contact for the public and counterparts at Member State and Union levels.
